financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: 100% of tuition, paid by SI directly to the Swedish university each semester

stipend.notes: Paid for the whole study period of a one- or two-year master's. No extensions, no programme changes, no extra money for family members.

additional_benefits: Travel grant: one-off SEK 15,000 (SEK 10,000 for Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova, Ukraine); not paid to those already living in Sweden
Membership of the SI Network for Global Professionals
Sweden Alumni Network membership after the scholarship

application_fee.notes: No fee to SI. The University Admissions in Sweden application fee (SEK 900, once per semester) must be paid by 1 Feb 2027, or you are not eligible. SI does not refund it.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: No SI requirement; the university and University Admissions set GPA/entry rules
language_proficiency: No SI requirement; English as required by the chosen master's programme (assessed by University Admissions)
eligibility_criteria.work_experience_years: At least 3,000 hours of work before February 2027, from at most three employers (for African, Asian and Latin American countries); proof of any work for Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova, Ukraine. Leadership experience also required.

country_specific_notes.note: Eligible. Needs 3,000+ hours of work experience. Nigeria is by far the most competitive country: in the 2026 round 5,678 Nigerians applied and 14 won (12 Global Professionals + 2 Pioneering Women in STEM), about 0.2%. No country quotas.
Public sector employees are not eligible.
Public sector employees are not eligible.

required_documents.name: Proof of work and leadership experience
required_documents.detail: On SI's template, signed and officially stamped by the employer or a notary

required_documents.name: Two letters of reference
required_documents.detail: On SI's template, signed and stamped (one must be work-based)

required_documents.name: Copy of valid passport or national ID card
Motivation
required_documents.detail: Written in the online portal (some applicants are randomly asked for a short video)

preparation_alerts: Apply to up to 4 eligible master's programmes on universityadmissions.se by 15 Jan 2027 and pay the SEK 900 fee and upload documents by 1 Feb 2027. Missing this makes you ineligible for SI.
You must be admitted (not reserve) to an eligible programme on 1 Apr 2027. Do not decline or change your admission offer.
SI templates and the list of eligible programmes are published on 13 Nov 2026; old-year templates are rejected.
Getting signed and stamped forms from employers (up to three) takes time; start early. Translations must be notarised.
Insurance is not included; check what the university provides. Arrange leave from your employer yourself.
